negatives.statement: The first broad recursive stale-label and route-label search exceeded its 60-second command wrapper before returning a result.
negatives.recovery: Replace the broad search with bounded direct reads of the owner-scoped phase files, classify inherited source references separately from current owner or route fields, and retain this timeout after the bounded review passes.

negatives.statement: A combined footprint and exact-file receipt patch was rejected before changing either file because the update hunk ended without valid context.
negatives.recovery: Apply the bounded footprint update and new exact-file receipt in separate valid patch operations, then rerun manifest, JSON, privacy, and staged-path checks.

negatives.statement: The first fresh detached evidence snapshot ran 276 repository tests with one failure because manifest byte counts used raw worktree sizes while Git materialized CRLF line endings; normalized content hashes still matched.
negatives.recovery: Retain the failed snapshot result, define manifest byte counts as LF-normalized lengths alongside normalized hashes, add a regression test, create an additive repair commit, and repeat all clean-snapshot validation without rewriting the evidence commit.

negatives.statement: The first repair validation ran 277 repository tests with two failures because the accessible report was regenerated after the manifest, leaving the report hash stale when the retained-negative count changed.
negatives.recovery: Retain the failed run and enforce packet generation, report generation, then a final manifest-refresh generation before any validator or repository suite.

boundary: Append every recovered x2 operational failure; never erase it after a later pass.
